Commentary.Commentary: We are back. The players are out in the middle. Shaheen Afridi to bowl first!
...THE CHASE...

The Kiwi bowlers have done a really good job. They first used the new ball to their power by swinging both ways but once it got old, they started to leak runs. However, they were brilliant on the field and did well to take wickets regularly. Now then, New Zealand look a big inexperienced on the batting side and on the flip side, Pakistan have their gun bowling back. It will be fascinating to see who comes out on top. Stay tuned.

Pakistan will feel they are 10-15 runs short here. Credit to New Zealand for the way they bowled and to take wickets at regular intervals. Pakistan did not get the best of start but the momentum shifted to the home side once Saim Ayub walked in the middle. The youngster showed no signs of pressure as he went big right from the word go. That gave Pakistan a good run along with Fakhar Zaman but unfortunately, Ayub was run out and since then they kept losing wickets. There were a couple of starts but no one stayed till the end.
OUT! TAKEN! Benjamin Lister gets his second! Fuller and outside off. Haris Rauf tries to go over long on but fails and finds James Neesham in the deep. Pakistan end with 182.
